posts.trend: PNB Q2 profit rises 12.8% to Rs 5,532 crore; bank in no hurry to increase deposit rates
posts.context: Older generations trust public sector banks purely because they have physical counters.
posts.angle: Public bank loyalty relies on physical passbooks, not competitive interest calculations.
slides:
"FD ka interest rate check kiya?"
"Interest nahi, safety dekho."
"Inflation rate pata hai?"
"Passbook entry karwa ke aao."
She has five passbooks wrapped in a plastic pouch.
posts.caption: Every family has one person who maintains physical bank passbooks.
posts.rank_verdict: Middle slide dialogue feels slightly repetitive before being saved by the excellent final image.
